tagline: Leading global investment management and wealth management firm
hero_kpi_rationale: Assets under management (AUM) are the primary revenue driver for AllianceBernstein, as the company is compensated based on a percentage of these assets. Significant AUM growth indicates strong performance and increased client confidence.

kpis.name: Assets under management
kpis.explanation: Total amount of assets managed by the company on behalf of its clients.
kpis.description: Assets under management (AUM) increased by 9.4% to $866.9 billion as of December 31, 2025, primarily driven by market appreciation of $86.0 billion.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in managed assets, driven by market appreciation.

kpis.name: Net revenues
kpis.explanation: Total revenues generated by the company after deduction of direct costs.
kpis.description: Net revenues increased by 1.2% to $4.5 billion in 2025, primarily due to higher base advisory fees.
kpis.signal: Slight growth in net revenues, supported by base advisory fees.

kpis.name: Operating income
kpis.explanation: A company's profit after deduction of all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating income decreased by 6.5% to $1.1 billion in 2025, impacted by higher operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Decline in operating income due to rising expenses.

kpis.name: Operating margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of operating profit relative to revenues.
kpis.description: Operating margin declined to 23.0% in 2025, from 24.7% in 2024, due to higher operating expenses.
kpis.signal: Declining operating margin, reflecting pressure on profitability.

kpis.name: Institutional assets under management
kpis.explanation: Assets managed for institutional clients such as pension funds and endowments.
kpis.description: Institutional AUM increased by 10.2% to $354.2 billion in 2025, primarily driven by market appreciation.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in institutional assets, indicating strong demand from large investors.

kpis.name: Retail assets under management
kpis.description: Retail AUM increased by 6.6% to $356.4 billion in 2025, primarily due to market appreciation, despite net outflows.
kpis.signal: Moderate growth in retail assets, despite net outflows.

kpis.name: Private wealth management assets under management
kpis.description: Private wealth management AUM increased by 14.4% to $156.3 billion in 2025, driven by market appreciation and net inflows.
kpis.signal: Strong growth in private wealth management assets, indicating appeal to high-net-worth clients.

kpis.name: Net outflows
kpis.explanation: Difference between client fund outflows and inflows.
kpis.description: Total net outflows amounted to $11.3 billion in 2025, resulting from net outflows of $4.6 billion in the Institutional segment and $9.1 billion in the Retail segment, partially offset by net inflows of $2.4 billion in private wealth management.
kpis.signal: Total net outflows, primarily driven by Institutional and Retail segments.

kpis.name: Bernstein Research Services revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue generated by the company's research activities.
kpis.description: Bernstein Research Services revenue decreased by 100% to $0 million in 2025, due to the deconsolidation of the BRS business and its contribution to joint ventures.
kpis.signal: Complete elimination of Bernstein Research Services revenue following deconsolidation.

kpis.name: Contingent payment arrangements gain
kpis.explanation: Gain realized from the revaluation of a contingent payment obligation.
kpis.description: There was no gain on contingent payment arrangements in 2025, compared to a $121.0 million gain recorded in 2024 related to the revaluation of contingent debt following the acquisition of AB CarVal.
kpis.signal: Absence of contingent payment arrangements gain in 2025, unlike in 2024.

risks.title: Cyberattacks
risks.score_rationale: The company explicitly mentions cybersecurity and data protection risks in its annual report.

risks.title: Regulation
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the financial sector, which could impact its operations and financial results.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive sector, which could negatively impact its market share and financial performance.

risks.title: Litigation
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to litigation and legal proceedings risks, which could negatively affect its operations and reputation.

risks.title: Dependence on EQH
risks.score_rationale: The company is highly dependent on its principal shareholder, EQH, which could negatively impact its operations and financial results.

risks.title: Credit Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to credit risks related to its investments and operations, which could negatively impact its financial results.

ai_positioning.summary: The company has no significant mention of artificial intelligence, machine learning, or similar technologies in its 10-K filing.
